description: ALBANY, NY –Speaker Carl Heastie today continued his annual statewide tour, visiting the Town of Liberty Summer Camp at Hanofee Park as well as the site of a future Head Start and childcare center in Middletown with Assemblymember Paula Elaine Kay.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Paula for Assembly
title: Assembly member Kay, Announcing more than $2.365 Million for the Town of Liberty's Summer Camp at Hanofee Park and $1 Million for the Construction of a New Head Start in Middletown | Paula for Assembly
